Kuma describes itself as “Stoat's most advanced all-in-one community and security bot”. To be fair to Kuma, it publishes a detailed privacy policy, lets members view, export and delete their data, says it doesn't keep copies of messages, and deletes some records automatically. Its code isn't public, so everything below comes from Kuma's own website, privacy policy and commands page. We first read them on 6 October 2026 and again in full on
What the November privacy policy changed:
Data in three tiers.

Essential data such as IDs, moderation records and settings; operational data such as join and leave events, logs and command usage; and optional data such as levels, economy and feeds, which is only collected once a server turns that feature on.
No copy of your messages.

When logging is on, the text of edited, deleted and automatically moderated messages goes to the server's own log channel on Stoat. Kuma keeps only a pointer to that post and reads it back when a moderator opens the dashboard.
Chat snapshots store IDs only.

When a report or punishment happens, Kuma records which of the last 30 messages were in the channel, not what they said. The text is fetched live when staff open the snapshot. Snapshots are on by default, deleted after 60 days, and owners can turn them off.
Short retention for some data.
Per-server daily message and command counts are kept for 60 days, uptime history for about 90 days, and login sessions for minutes.
Members control their own data.

A privacy hub lets members check what Kuma holds about them, download it or ask for deletion, and Kuma says it handles emailed requests within 30 days. Kuma's own surveys are opt-in and anonymous by default.

Kuma publishes a detailed privacy policy, rewritten in November 2026, lets members view, export and delete their data, keeps logged message text only in the server's own log channel and stores chat snapshots as message IDs for 60 days.
Most data is kept while Kuma is in a server and deleted after it leaves only on request.
Delete a server's data automatically when Kuma is removed.
